hook: Across 149 countries, 252 million hectares of degraded land are healing.

sections.voiceover: Across 149 countries, 252 million hectares of degraded land are healing.
sections.visual_cue: Satellite footage showing a transition from barren land to lush green vegetation.

sections.voiceover: Are these 149 countries seeing real results from their massive, coordinated environmental restoration work?
sections.visual_cue: A document cover showing the UN Environment Programme logo and a forest landscape.

sections.voiceover: Doreen Robinson reports this restoration effort is doing more than just healing our degraded soil.
sections.visual_cue: Close-up of workers planting native trees in a degraded landscape.

sections.voiceover: These combined projects have officially created over one million green jobs for workers worldwide. Nairobi is now tracking this massive comeback across 252 million hectares of our planet.
